title: Houston, TX — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Houston, TX: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Houston is a city in TX with a population of 2,314,157. Energy capital of the world with no state income tax, diverse culture, and affordable living. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9a growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.3.
